name: Mino (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Mino city emblem in white: three outlined hexagons each enclosing a stylised character, arranged in a triangle.
history: Municipal flag of Mino, a city in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1954.

features.role: Mino city emblem — three outlined hexagons each enclosing a stylised character, arranged in a triangle
